subject: [PATCH v2 11/12] mm/collapse: declare the collapse interface in collapse.h

2026-09-10.patch_summary: This patch declares the collapse interface in collapse.h, making it possible to use the collapse functionality from other files. The interface includes functions for setting up and releasing a control structure, scanning and collapsing PTE tables, and revalidating VMAs after a collapse operation. This is a preparation step for implementing MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c and does not introduce any functional changes.

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Reviewer Zi Yan suggested that individual functions in collapse.h should have their own documentation, explaining their requirements and actions, rather than relying on a general description at the top.
reviews.raw_body:
It might be better to document each function individually about the
requirements and what each does instead of putting everything above.

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch declares the collapse interface in collapse.h, making it possible to use the collapse functionality from other kernel files. The interface includes four functions: collapse_control_init, collapse_scan_pmd, collapse_run_pmd, and collapse_control_release, which are called in a specific order with the mmap_lock held at different times. Additionally, two new functions are added: collapse_possible_orders and collapse_vma_revalidate. This patch is part of a larger effort to implement MADV_COLLAPSE in madvise.c and does not introduce any functional changes.
